name: Boys Noize at Switch
description: The German DJ and producer Boys Noize takes over the decks at Switch for a high-energy night.
longDescription:
Boys Noize, the German DJ and producer also known as Alex Ridha, brings his distinct sound to Switch in Porto. Known for his genre-bending approach that incorporates techno, electro, and house, Ridha has established himself as a prominent figure in electronic music since the early 2000s. His sets are characterized by their dynamic energy and innovative track selection, reflecting a career that includes numerous acclaimed releases on his own Boysnoize Records label and collaborations with artists across various musical spectrums.

Attendees can expect a high-energy atmosphere within Switch, a venue recognized for its club nights. The event is geared towards an adult audience interested in electronic music and club culture. The focus will be on the DJ set, providing a continuous flow of music designed for dancing.

This is a ticketed event. Specific details regarding ticket availability and purchase points are typically released closer to the date. Switch is located in Porto, generally accessible via public transport options such as metro and bus, with specific routes depending on the starting point within the city.
